隐藏 / 显示 R18 内容（顶栏 R18 按钮还可以切换为只看 R18）: Hide / show R18 content (the R18 button in the top bar can also show R18 only)
关闭大图或详情，或取消选择: Close the large view or details, or clear the selection
自动识别结果默认生效，仅需移除错误项。人工判定优先于自动识别，不会被后续识别覆盖: Automatic recognition counts by default; you only remove what is wrong. Your decisions take precedence and are never overwritten by later recognition. Everything is undoable.
